integrity: All stated universal operator-norm identities and equality descriptions are supported by the included analytic proof. Finite diagnostics are supplementary and cannot certify universality.
limitations: Equal-weight two-channel projection only; no general projection family.
Scalar Clarkson estimates are prior knowledge and may allow equivalent formulations in older literature.
No near-extremizer stability or complete endpoint extremizer classifications.
title: Sharp power norms and extremizer switching for a two-channel Banach shift
